The judicial system is functioning as a check on executive power, upholding the constitutional requirement for legislative oversight.

By framing a private vanity project as a national security mandate, the administration attempts to project its own desire for power onto the public interest, creating a pretext to bypass democratic checks.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The systemic strain of ignoring law for personal gain creates instability.

The Unavoidable Truth: Congress holds the power of the purse.

The Unavoidable Lie: A ballroom is a national security necessity.
